name: Client Desk
description: A client portal for web-design/dev freelancers. Onboarding questionnaire, per-project progress dashboards, quotes the client approves online, invoices with Stripe card payments plus attached agreement + requirements brief, file deliverables, project comments, team assignment, support tickets, a searchable client directory that separates direct vs Fiverr clients, per-client custom login links, deadline + overdue automations, an analytics overview, and role-based permissions.
author: Rakib Hasan

permissions.label: Create / edit / archive clients + access links
Create / edit projects, progress, files, comments
Respond to and close support tickets
